Their exact characteristic polynomials and derivatives produce P(r); P is strictly increasing on (0,1) and has exactly one optimizer root in (0,2/3), with both time-endpoint lower bounds zero. The critical root is on the lower rather than upper eigenvalue branch. An explicit stable inverse follows directly. `verify.py` rechecks all nontrivial symbolic identities and finite corroboration; neither finite enumeration nor a solver result is used as the infinite proof.
